text:
It took Jason Robertson 5:20 against Washington to score three goals, the third-fastest hat trick in Stars history, behind only Tom McCarthy and Jamie Benn, as NHL.com's Tom Gulitti noted. It capped a strong stretch: 13 points in his last ten games, against about 11.3 we'd expect at his ice time.

For the season it's 8 goals and 18 points in 16 games, and very little looks borrowed. He's shooting 15.4%, a touch above the 14.4% middle of his range, and Dallas takes 56.4% of five-on-five shot attempts with him on. Evolving-Hockey ranked him 14th among 401 forwards last season at 3.1 wins above replacement, driving play at the 98th percentile.

He isn't fast (12th percentile top speed) and never needed to be. He wins on positioning: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 7.1 scoring chances per 60 from the home-plate area, 90th percentile.

The louder story may be off the ice. The Hockey News frames his next contract as a major test for GM Jim Nill, and weeks like this one only raise the price. Our projection: 33 to 51 goals.
headline: Robertson's hat trick came with receipts
